Definition: from G5087; a deposit, i.e. wealth (literally or figuratively):--treasure.
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses thēsaurós where it means treasure. In Matthew 2:11, they had opened their treasures. Wherever it appears, the word means this and not something vaguer.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the treasure that lasts is not stored where moth and rust can reach it. That is why I come back to thēsaurós whenever I need to remember what is true.
